name: Golden Frostbound Oath
effectTemplate: Increase DEF by <color=#99FFFFFF>{0}</color>. When the equipping character's Elemental Skill or Lunar-Crystallize attacks hit opponents, gain the Frost Fae's Favor effect for 6s: Geo DMG inflicted by the equipping character increases by <color=#99FFFFFF>{1}</color>, Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG increases by <color=#99FFFFFF>{2}</color>. While this effect is active, if there are Moondrifts near the equipping character, all other nearby party members will gain the Frost Fae's Mischief effect: Geo DMG dealt increases by <color=#99FFFFFF>{3}</color> and Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG increases by <color=#99FFFFFF>{4}</color>. This effect can be triggered even when the equipping character is off-field.
